findings.description: The KMS key does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation is absent, defaulting to false). The key encrypts audit trail data, so a long-lived, never-rotated key materially increases the impact of key compromise and violates standard cryptographic key management expectations.

The alias name interpolates a hard-coded value (local.env_prefix.value) rather than a variable or data source, embedding an environment-specific string directly into the configuration. This is a secret-in-configuration pattern that leaks into version control and state; environment identifiers should come from variables or remote state.
